why_superseded_before_results: The v0.3 arbitrary-mismatch-pair optimistic bound is too loose to discriminate the mechanism because it ignores whether a mismatch set can arise from a tip-state assignment. The first v0.3.1 workflow attempt then failed before producing any result because successful calibrations do not persist full pilot grids; this storage fact is now incorporated explicitly.
purpose: Among categorical systems that failed S3 calibration, test whether the ceiling arises because stronger latent phylogenetic memory drives thresholded binary states toward monomorphism before the frozen rho=0.15 benchmark becomes admissibly measurable.
source: The stored S3 pilot calibration grids from the 683 novel known-truth system JSONs in workflow 37086693588. Full grids are persisted for calibration failures; successful calibrations retain only summary quantities. No real trait values or observed memory rho are used.
primary_scope: The 220 nominal-categorical systems with S3 hold_reason=CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET, whose failure grids were stored by the frozen calibration code.
sanity_scope: The 60 continuous-scalar CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET systems, used only to contrast valid_fraction behavior under the same pilot machinery.
mechanistic_identity: For nominal binary systems, binary_effects is finite only when both states occur among tips. Therefore pilot valid_fraction is the fraction of simulated replicates retaining polymorphism sufficient to define the mismatch correlation.
tests: For each no-bracket system, record the maximum finite pilot median rho over all stored lambda values and the valid_fraction at that lambda.
Separately record the maximum finite pilot median rho among grid points satisfying the already-frozen valid_fraction >= 0.90 requirement.
Record systems with a stored grid but no finite pilot median at any lambda as COMPLETE_VALIDITY_COLLAPSE.
Within each no-bracket system, summarize the rank association of log(lambda) with valid_fraction and, where defined, with pilot median rho.

Classify categorical no-bracket systems as VALIDITY_COLLAPSE if the unconstrained grid reaches rho >= 0.15 but the admissible grid does not; as EFFECT_CEILING if finite unconstrained medians never reach rho=0.15; and retain any remaining algorithmic edge case separately.
primary_prediction: If loss of binary polymorphism is the dominant mechanism, VALIDITY_COLLAPSE plus COMPLETE_VALIDITY_COLLAPSE will dominate and valid_fraction will fall as lambda increases. If EFFECT_CEILING dominates, the limitation arises before complete state collapse in the generator-tree-estimator coupling.
interpretation_guard: This analysis concerns measurement under a frozen latent-OU-threshold generator and binary mismatch estimator. It is not evidence that categorical biological traits are intrinsically less conserved.
